### Finance, Business and Economics Option

---

A maximum of 4 units from the following FBE courses may be applied toward the minor in Legal Studies.

notes.text: The minor in Legal Studies enables students to deepen their understanding of the U.S. legal system and provides them with the fundamentals of law. It combines courses in law, economics, history, philosophy, political science and public policy taught at the Gould School of Law, Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences, and the Sol Price School of Public Policy.
